meta.name: Dracula
meta.description: Transylvania, 1897. The blood-drinking Count Dracula is drawing his plans against Victorian London. And be warned: the dead travel fast.

videos.title: The Rules of the Beast
videos.overview: English lawyer Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to meet a new client —and a legend is about to get fresh blood.

videos.title: Blood Vessel
videos.overview: The crew and passengers aboard the Russian ship, The Demeter, are locked in a life-or-death struggle to stop Count Dracula before he reaches England.

videos.title: The Dark Compass
videos.overview: Count Dracula has made it to England —a new world pulsing with fresh blood— and lays his plans to spread his foul vampire contagion. But why does he set his sights on the seemingly ordinary Lucy Westenra?
